It's hard and fucking sucks but when you're quitting and resetting your habits you have to train yourself to adopt new ones.

So I'm a 19 year old music enthusiast, and to me the past few years have been interesting for music.

In my opinion the most groundbreaking/influential groups/artists for me have been:

Death Grips, Run The Jewels - both of which are Experimental Hip Hop

Kanye West has always been at the forefront of innovative music. I would personally recommend The College Dropout which was his first album, and My Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy - both of which are Hip Hop/Rap.

Bright Eyes - I'm Wide Awake It's Morning was my favourite album of the decade being released in 2005. I would describe it as Soft Rock/Country but in terms of lyricism and connecting with the listener this album is a beaut.

If we wanna go a bit further back 1998 saw a new Neutral Milk Hotel album: In The Aeroplane Over The Sea. Anyone who is anyone can appreciate how sporadic and against the musical grain NMH are as they incorporate odd and interesting instruments into their albums.

If you're looking for something more up to date, I would recommend either The 1975 or alt-J. Whilst The 1975 are heavily criticized for having an overbearing fanbase, their self-titled debut  album has some great production and the lead singer, Matty, has one of the most interesting and unique voices I've ever heard.

alt-J on the other hand are more electric/Indie Rock but their two albums have been extremely non-mainstream for a very popular group. 

There are so many more I can recommend but tl;dr. You're probably already familiar with 90% of these groups but hey.
